corrections.name: Boulder Break
corrections.character_source: Great Ape Nappa; Great Ape Bardock
corrections.reason: Current sources establish Boulder Break as a Super Skill used by Great Apes; its physical boulder-slam behavior supports Strike taxonomy. Cost remains unresolved.

notes: Gigantic Slam was absent from the canonical catalog and is represented as a new record. Bloody Sauce was added in Batch 285 and is corrected here. Boulder Break, Boulder Toss, Energy Cannon, and Beam Rifle are retained as formal corrections to Batch 283. Giant Storm is intentionally not included because it is an Ultimate Skill and will be handled in the appropriate Ultimate catalog. Added Darkness Mixer and Pretty Charge after dedicated source verification; both were absent from canonical skills.json.
